substance_first_changes: Bound Entergy utility-side River Bend announcement to the AI/data-center case without treating it as a filed tariff or ESA.
Bound West Feliciana IDB/PILOT revenue architecture and distribution-schedule reporting as public-upside claims that require primary IDB instruments.
Bound property-owner rebate sequencing and official parish public-record routing as an executable instrument-retrieval ladder.
Refactored the River Bend proof debt so private creditor/lease protections, gross local revenue, and public hold-harmless proof are separate tracks.

audit_refactor.finding: The riskiest overclaim was treating private counterparty protection or gross PILOT proceeds as if they proved ratepayer/taxpayer/water-user protection.
audit_refactor.change: Rev0355 separates source tracks into utility service/ratebase, IDB/PILOT distribution, water/public works, incentive/clawback, and actual-load monitoring instruments.

IDB distribution resolution and taxing-body allocations
